name: Edmonton Expo
blurb: FAN EXPO HQ's Alberta show at the Edmonton Expo Centre, with celebrity, anime, gaming and comic-creator guests.

editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD: Event "EDMONTON EXPO" 2027-09-17 -> 2027-09-19 @ Edmonton Expo Centre; same text on page: 'SEPTEMBER 17 - 19, 2027 EDMONTON EXPO CENTRE'.

notes: Multi-city FAN EXPO HQ brand. Both the celebrities and comic-creators guest pages show only a 'PAST FAN FAVE GUESTS INCLUDED' section (John Cena, Temuera Morrison, Kyle Baker, Tom Cook, etc.) with 'sign up for updates' copy, not a 2027 lineup, so guests is 'none-yet'. Cover uses the distinct blue/green 'EDMONTON EXPO' wordmark logo (the only Edmonton-specific branded asset found; carousel/hero images are generic stock photos).
